summary: Implementation plan for End-to-End MRO Line Engineer Interactive Workflows: (1) Mandatory Rectification & Post-Repair Measurement Worksheet before clearing Red/Amber component defects, (2) Live Micrometer & Telemetry Gauge Input on every 3D Component Card with real-time AMM limit evaluation, (3) Final Aircraft Certificate of Release to Service (CRS) Dispatch Sign-Off Panel on the Flight Status screen, and (4) 1-Click Active Flight Crew Tech Log pre-loading in Incident Intake.
